commits.message: chore: bump to 6.0.0-18

feat: replace devblog by CM community

Devblog is deprecated all its functionality are now integrated on CM community.
fix(publish): preserve upload errors and correct streaming reads

fix: resolve IoT engine test utilities import path by MES version

fix: use dist test utilities path from MES 11.1.0
docs: add contributing guide with dev container setup and troubleshooting
fix(templates): correct k6 performance test packaging

fix: forward plugin arguments verbatim so plugins can display help

Plugin arguments were parsed by the CLI's own parser and only the
unmatched tokens were forwarded, so options the CLI also knows
(-h, -?, --help, and the -- separator) never reached the plugin.
The arguments after the plugin name are now passed through as typed.

A single -- immediately after the plugin name is still treated as a
separator and not forwarded, so `cmf <plugin> -- --help` keeps working
as before; a -- anywhere else is passed to the plugin.

The CLI no longer parses the plugin's arguments at all. The log level
default (cmf_cli_loglevel, SYSTEM_DEBUG) is applied to the CLI's own
logging around the plugin explicitly, through the new
LoggerHelpers.ApplyLogLevelFromEnvironment.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(pack): populate virtual root package dependencies

Replace hardcoded root template dependencies with in-memory dependencies during packing.
Include deployment metadata only for MES 10 and earlier, excluding App repositories.
Use normal manifest serialization without rewriting source packages.

Cover virtual dependencies, repeated packing, dry runs, and missing dependency collections.
Document that changelog updates belong to version bumps.

fix(errors): report expected CLI failures without stack traces

Use CliException for expected validation, credential, and repository failures
while preserving messages and exit codes. Narrow credential wrappers so
controlled errors, cancellation, and programming errors retain their handling.

Handle malformed portal JWT payloads consistently and add regression coverage
and help documentation. Leave CHANGES.md and internal-state guards unchanged.
fix(tests): restore shared services after MES 12 help tests
fix(auth): report invalid portal tokens as controlled CLI errors
fix(init): use next devcontainer tags for prerelease CLI versions
build(docs): replace Earthly with Docker and standardize MkDocs
build(devcontainer): add Docker-in-Docker for docs development
chore!: enable streaming publish and repository clients by default

fix(publish): stream large backup conversion and manifest discovery

Stream ZIP entries directly into TGZ archives and discover TGZ manifests without buffering the full decompressed archive. Preserve XML-manifest precedence and JSON fallback.

Cover complete publishing with backup entries larger than 2 GiB for XML and JSON-only packages, alongside empty entries, manifest precedence, missing manifests, and streaming upload regressions.
fix(init): install next CLI feature for prerelease versions
chore: bump to 6.0.0-19
build(discourse): announcements

chore: prepare for cli v6 release

merge to main
